pages.text:
ELEGU +200pple/day
The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) supports the Government of Uganda to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with an emphasis on Goal 2 (Zero Hunger) and Goal 17 (Partnerships for the Goals). It is in this regard that we stepped up our supply chain and engineering eﬀorts in April 2020 as COVID-19 spread in Uganda, assisting the joint eﬀorts of the government and humanitarian actors to contain the pandemic. We provide technical advice, install physical assets and strengthen local capacity for quality service delivery even while we continue to meet food and nutrition needs of refugees and Ugandans in the Karamoja region on a regular basis. WFP has had a permanent representation since May 2020 at the Ministry of Health with a Logistics Oﬃcer seconded to work as co-chair of the Logistics sub-committee of the National Taskforce.

Pre-Fabricated Oﬃce
Cyanika|Vurra
At Cyanika and Vurra, WFP helped to install semi-permanent structures, which accommodate furniture, oﬃce and laboratories for health workers, as well as thermo-scanners to boost the capacity for eﬃcient screening and testing of truck operators and other travellers. Malaba, Busia, Elegu, Mirama Hills and Mutukula will also receive this kind of support.
